nodes.label: Science and tech
nodes.question: What technical advances are highlighted in the context of improving nuclear systems?
nodes.answer: The paragraph highlights technical advances in nuclear thermal hydraulics, reactor design enhancements, and hybrid nuclear-renewable systems.
nodes.paragraph: Technical advances in nuclear thermal hydraulics, reactor design enhancements, and hybrid nuclear- renewable systems underscore the potential for technologicalbreakthroughs to improve the safety, ef ciency, and versa-tility of nuclear systems. Contributions to the readiness of B Afaque Shams afaque.shams@kfupm.edu.sa Khaled Al-Athel kathel@kfupm.edu.sa Iztok Tiselj Iztok.Tiselj@ijs.si Bojan Ni ceno bojan.niceno@psi.ch Ihsan ulhaq Toor ihsan@kfupm.edu.sa 1King Fahd University of Petroleum and Minerals (KFUPM),Dhahran, Saudi Arabia 2Jo ef Stefan Institute (JSI), Ljubljana, Slovenia 3Paul Scherrer Institute (PSI), Villigen, Switzerlandcodes, standards, and high-performance computing highlight the importance of robust frameworks and computational tools for the development and safety assessment of next-generationreactors. This special issue also delves into material science, addressing challenges related to fuel cladding, reactor com- ponents, and material degradation in nuclear facilities, whichare vital for the long-term and reliable operation of nuclear systems. Studies on severe accident analysis, reactor dynam- ics, and risk assessments emphasize the importance of safetyand security in the operation of nuclear plants. Furthermore, this collection provides perspectives on the socio-economic and policy aspects of nuclear energy,including market readiness, legal frameworks, and interna-tional cooperation.

nodes.label: Factual
nodes.question: Which countries have a higher installed capacity of renewables, especially hydropower?
nodes.answer: Countries like Austria, Canada, and New Zealand have a higher installed capacity of renewables, especially hydropower.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Clean energy|Hydropower plants|Advances in hydropower technology_qna_002
nodes.label: Analysis
nodes.question: What is the trend in installed capacity for hydropower and fossil fuel energy resources despite being the most-installed energy resources among renewables and on average, respectively?
nodes.answer: Both hydropower and fossil fuel energy resources face decreasing trends in year-on-year installed capacity.
